display.purpose: The nameplate, once, in register 01. Archivo Expanded, uppercase. Ceiling of the system at 6rem.

headline.purpose: Register headings, set on the same baseline as the mono sheet number.

record.purpose: Project titles and the email at the foot of the sheet. Deliberately larger than the register heading above it — the work is where the pen jumps.

title.purpose: Timeline entries, component lines, certification rows. Subordinate headings drop out of Expanded into Narrow rather than merely getting smaller.

lead.purpose: One paragraph directly under a heading, capped at 46ch when it opens a register. Rises to clamp(1.1875rem, 2.4vw, 1.75rem) on the opening statement.

body.purpose: Running prose, Normal width, light weight. Measure capped between 46ch and 68ch; nothing on the page exceeds 78ch.

label.purpose: Anything a visitor reads as language at label scale — roles, organisations, issuers, group subheadings, marked-empty notices. Actions use the same face at 0.14em tracking.

data.purpose: A reading, never a word. Coordinates, station codes, hour ticks, sheet counters, years, phase marks. Never a role, an organisation or an issuer.

motion.name: ease-pen
motion.purpose: The only easing in the system. Every transition and every keyframe uses it; the band reveal is the one exception, on steps(1, end).

motion.name: pen-draw
motion.value: stroke-dasharray: 1 1; animation: pen-draw 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both — stroke-dashoffset 1 → 0
motion.purpose: A line writing itself. The hero record runs it at 2.6s with a 0.15s delay. CSS-driven, so a throttled tab cannot strand the stroke half-written.

motion.name: band-in
motion.value: animation: band-in 0.72s steps(1, end) both — clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) → 66% → 33% → 0
motion.purpose: A record arriving the way a test strip is read: three held bands, never a fade. Scoped to repeated records — project traces, channel rows, certification rows.

motion.name: pick-in
motion.value: animation: pick-in 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 1.1s both — clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) → 0
motion.purpose: The analyst's pick wiping down its own line once the pen has passed the onset. Geometry, not opacity.

motion.name: register-scrub
motion.value: pathLength bound to scrollYProgress, offset ['start end', 'start 35%']
motion.purpose: The register arrival. The pen's position is scroll, so the trace is literally recorded as the register comes into view. Each register declares its own amplitude, 0.46–0.95.

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Value shift following a geometry change. Never carries the state on its own.

motion.name: state-geometry
motion.purpose: Marker width, leader-line draw, arrowhead travel, title slide. The geometry is the state.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration: 0.01ms; clip-path: none on every [data-band]; scrubbed and drawn traces render already-written
motion.purpose: Every entrance lands at its finished state. No entrance in this system can leave content unreachable.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: An action written the way the instrument writes one: a label over a leader line, with an arrowhead that travels along it. No pills, no filled buttons.
components.html: VER EL REGISTRO

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: The same annotation at secondary weight: dust label over a hairline leader. Identical geometry — only the resting value differs.
components.html: DESCARGAR CV

components.name: Register Rail
components.description: The sheet index pinned in the left margin, with the title block at its foot. State is the marker: a 3px bone bar against a 1px track. Value only follows.
components.html:

  • 03TRAYECTORIA
ESCRIBIRGITHUBCV

components.name: Channel Selector
components.description: The locale switch, written as the control that picks which axis of the instrument you are reading. Active takes the 3px rule, inactive keeps the hairline. Not a pill, not a toggle.

components.name: Record Row
components.description: This system's card: no background, no border box, no radius, no shadow. A hairline on top, the title and year on one baseline, and the project's own trace beneath. Hover thickens the trace and slides the title.

components.name: Field Row
components.description: The page is static and has no form; what it has instead is the field row. A field label names the field, the value sits beside it, a hairline separates. Terms are set, not boxed — no chips.

components.name: Trace with Pick Mark
components.description: The signature component and the page's only generated media: a seeded seismogram — two octaves of noise under an exponential event envelope — drawn by stroke-dashoffset, with an analyst's pick wiping down its own line at the onset. Amplitude is texture, never a measurement of the work.

components.name: Image Frame
components.description: Every raster on the sheet: a 1px hairline frame, square corners, no padding, no shadow, content desaturated with a contrast lift. The caption beneath is a data label. Empty project slots take the same frame.

components.name: Register Heading
components.description: How every register announces itself: a hairline with the scroll-scrubbed arrival trace written across it, then the mono sheet number sitting on the heading's own baseline, then an optional lead capped at 46ch.

narrative.northStar: The Drum Sheet Read as a Negative
narrative.overview:
The page is one continuous seismic recording and the visitor is reading the drum. A printed time grid runs behind everything; a pen writes across it; the content is what the pen wrote. Quiet material is a flat trace and the work is where the pen jumps. This is not a decorative theme laid over a portfolio — the instrument is the information architecture. Six numbered registers run top to bottom, a sheet index sits pinned in the left margin with the title block at its foot, and the foot of the page closes the record with SHEET 06 / 06 · FIN.

The density is that of a technical recording rather than a brochure: hairline rules instead of containers, field labels instead of headings-with-eyebrows, measured facts instead of adjectives. Nothing is boxed. Where a conventional layout would reach for a card, a pill, a chip, or an icon set, this system sets the term as type on a ruled row and lets the rule do the separating. The ground is unlit (#08090a) and the ink is bone (#f2f0eb): the sheet is read as a photographic negative of a paper seismogram, which is what buys the darkness its reason to exist.

The system is deliberately colourless. There is no accent anywhere, and there is no shadow anywhere. Emphasis is built from three things only — value, type width, and line weight. Confirmed rejections: the portfolio card grid, the hero-metric row, the eyebrow label above a heading, the uniform fade-up on every section wrapper, and any glyph icon standing in for a label or for content.
keyCharacteristics: Zero hue: seven neutral tokens, no accent, no decorative colour.
One type family on its width axis (Archivo Variable, wdth 62–125), with a mono reserved strictly for measured data.
Elevation is a 1px rule or nothing — no shadows, no glass, no backdrop blur, no corner radius.
State is carried by line weight and marker geometry; value shift only follows it.
Nothing enters from opacity: 0; entrances are pen draws and stepped bands.
Every entrance lands at its finished state under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The No-Hue Rule
rules.body: There is no accent colour and there never will be one. If something needs to come forward, it moves up the neutral ramp, widens, or gains line weight. A chromatic value introduced anywhere on this sheet breaks the negative.

rules.name: The Pencil Floor Rule
rules.body: Pencil (#8a8782) is the faintest value any text may take. Nothing on this page is set in a value closer to the ground than that, and the hairline rule is never used as a text colour.

rules.name: The Grayscale Raster Rule
rules.body: Every photographic raster ships desaturated with a contrast lift — the station plate at grayscale contrast-[1.08] brightness-[0.92], project images at grayscale contrast-[1.05]. A colour photograph on this sheet would be the only hue on the page.

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is width before it is size. Display and record type is Expanded (125%), prose is Normal (100%), labels and subordinate headings are Narrow (78%). Never add a second family to create contrast the width axis already provides.

rules.name: The Measured-Data Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is reserved for measurements — coordinates, timestamps, station codes, counters, sheet numbers, years, phase marks. Anything a visitor reads as language belongs in field-label, never in mono. A role, an organisation, or an issuer set in mono is a bug, not a style.

rules.name: The Six-Rem Ceiling
rules.body: Display type stops at 6rem (96px measured) and tracking never tightens past -0.035em. Those are the two walls of the type system.

rules.name: The One Container Rule
rules.body: Every section and the margin rail share the single sheet container. A section that invents its own max-width or padding breaks the sheet's left datum, which is the one alignment the entire page is built on.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Record Rule
rules.body: Traces and the time grid run edge to edge because the drum sheet does; type always holds the sheet's own margin. The hero nameplate is locked to the station block's datum, never to the trace's.

rules.name: The Hairline-Or-Nothing Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated by a 1px rule or it is not separated at all. If a layout feels unclear, the answer is a rule, more space, or a value step — never a shadow and never a radius.

rules.name: The Opaque Overlay Rule
rules.body: Anything that covers the sheet is opaque ink. Translucency and blur would reveal the grid moving behind an overlay, which reads as glass and breaks the negative.

rules.name: The Square Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the sheet has a corner radius. A rounded container is the single fastest way to make this page look like a template.

rules.name: The Drawn-Marks-Only Rule
rules.body: The only marks on the page are instrument geometry drawn inline: trace, triangle, arrowhead, hairline. No icon library, no icon font, and no glyph standing in for a label or for content — if a thing needs naming, it gets a field-label.

rules.name: The Weight-Carries-State Rule
rules.body: Active state is geometry: a 3px mark against a 1px track. Value shift follows the geometry and never carries the state alone, and a colour swap is never the state.

rules.name: The Pen-Is-The-Motion Rule
rules.body: The authored moment is the pen writing. Everything else holds still. One page, one moving thing at a time.

rules.name: The Nothing-Fades-In Rule
rules.body: No element on this page enters from opacity: 0. Lines enter by stroke-dashoffset (the pen-draw keyframe); records enter by discrete clip-path bands (the band-in keyframe — three held steps over 0.72s with steps(1, end), read like a test strip); marks enter by wiping down their own line (pick-in, 0.42s). All three are CSS-driven, because a script-driven tween can be dropped mid-stroke by a throttled tab and leave the record permanently half-written.

rules.name: The Content-Never-Waits Rule
rules.body: Only generated media is ever withheld for an entrance. Names, headings, prose and links are on the sheet from first paint, and the band reveal is gated by a hook that never hides what is already on screen, treats a missing IntersectionObserver as arrived, and carries a 6-second backstop. A reveal that can fail closed is worse than no reveal.

dos: Do build hierarchy from value, type width, and line weight only. Those three are the whole emphasis system.
Do separate content with a 1px rule hairline and vertical space. A ruled row is this system's card.
Do keep display type at or under 6rem and tracking at or above -0.035em.
Do set anything a visitor reads as language in field-label, and reserve data-label's mono for actual measurements.
Do route every section and the margin rail through the single sheet container so the left datum holds.
Do encode state as a 3px mark against a 1px track, letting value follow the geometry.
Do keep text at Pencil (#8a8782) or lighter, and keep any measure at or under 78ch.
Do desaturate every photographic raster and give it a hairline frame with square corners.
Do ship an absent artifact as a marked, named empty slot in a field-label — a visible placeholder is honest, invented content is not.
Do land every entrance at its finished state under prefers-reduced-motion, and drive entrances from CSS rather than the frame loop.
donts: Don't introduce an accent colour, a gradient, or a colour photograph. Seven neutrals is the entire palette.
Don't add a box-shadow, a drop-shadow, a backdrop-filter, or a translucent panel. Elevation is a hairline or nothing.
Don't give anything a corner radius.
Don't box a term. No cards, no pills, no chips, no tag backgrounds — stack items and skills are set as type on a row.
Don't add an icon library, an icon font, or a glyph standing in for a label or for content. The only marks are the trace, the triangle, the arrowhead, and the hairline, drawn inline.
Don't animate anything in from opacity: 0, and don't give every section the same entrance — the register arrival is a scrub and the record arrival is a band.
Don't withhold text, a heading, or a link behind a scroll observer. Only generated media waits.
Don't add a second type family to create contrast the width axis already provides, and don't set a role, organisation, or issuer in mono.
Don't place an eyebrow or kicker above a heading. A field-label names a data field or heads a subordinate group; it is never decoration stacked over a larger heading.
Don't let a section declare its own container width, or lock the nameplate to anything but the station block's datum.
